'''Guldus Bemm''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who became the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Canyon Mining Facility]]. He tried to set a trap for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in an attempt to capture him for the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Bregius Golthan]].
